build_pybind11_extension: build a C++11+ extension module with pybind11 using Pybind11Extension with auto C++ standard flags
build_ext_auto_cpp_level: build extensions using the customized build_ext class that auto-searches for the highest supported C++ level
generate_intree_extensions: generate Pybind11Extension objects from source files located directly in a Python source tree using intree_extensions
enable_parallel_compile: enable parallel compilation by installing ParallelCompile with an environment variable to control build threads
check_compiler_flag: check if a compiler supports a specific flag using has_flag to validate compile options
